_comment: B74 — Crypto universe selection criteria for passive OHLC capture. Universe is computed dynamically from Kraken's AssetPairs REST endpoint at startup AND refreshed daily via the system cron at server/scripts/b74-refresh-universe.ts (03:00 UTC). Filters out dead pairs and stablecoin/stablecoin degenerates. Per Langston cc-inbox #867 + #869: $10k 24h volume floor is conservative — could go to $5k while still filtering garbage; tunable via module_constants.passive_archive.b74_crypto_min_volume_24h_usd without redeploy.

filter._minVolumeNote: Override comes from module_constants.passive_archive.b74_crypto_min_volume_24h_usd at runtime. This file's value is the documented default; runtime tuning happens in DB.
